meta.about: A `style` argument handed to edit_text. The refusal names the tool it belongs to and the retry dispatches it.
meta.recorded-outcome: asked to hide the last bullet, Gemma emitted edit_text({"target": "bullet 4", "style": "display: none"}) — the right target and the right declaration, on the wrong tool. `Give me the new text.` answered a question nobody had asked, named nothing, carried no `retry`, and the turn was over.
meta.guards: two replies for one ask. Drop the `style` branch from edit_text's missing-text refusal, or its `retry: true`, and this consumes one reply — reported as an unused reply AND as one call where two were expected.
